description: Use this only when the user asks to start monitoring a radio or live stream. AudD then recognizes the stream continuously and sends results to the callback URL: by default after each song ends, or as soon as a song starts with callbacks="before" (those results have no play length). radio_id is the user's own integer for the stream and must be unique on the account. The account's streams plan needs a free stream slot.

callbacks.description: Optional: "before" sends results when a song starts instead of when it ends

radio_id.description: Any integer that will identify this stream, unique on the account

url.description: Stream URL (Icecast, HLS, DASH, m3u/m3u8, ...) or a shortcut: twitch:<channel name>, youtube:<video id>, youtube-ch:<channel id>

name: add_stream
title: Add a stream for continuous recognition
